title: Render a generated semantic SVG diagram
summary: Extended kp.llm-animation-draft.v1 with exact allowlisted DiagramScene objects and compiled them through the shared draft compiler. Added a generated input-transform-output pipeline animation, deterministic semantic SVG adapter, editor registration and catalog exposure. The intermediate node enters, the direct edge fans out, labels replace independently, and rewind mirrors progress on the existing player clock.

sourceRefs.summary: Run contract whose stored slice next-action.kp.semantic-transition.diagram-svg-v0 was materialized into a child action.
Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved thirty-slice implementation plan and boundaries.
Constrained DiagramScene draft shape and nested validation.
Shared equation and diagram draft compilation.
Generated semantic pipeline diagram draft and AnimationAsset.
Deterministic shared-clock semantic SVG diagram renderer.
Diagram compiler, catalog, forward, and rewind coverage.
Visible incremental SVG lifecycle browser gate.

expectedLearning: Whether Render a generated semantic SVG diagram can be completed inside KP Semantic Incremental Transition And LLM Authoring V0.
allowedWork: Only the approved semantic correspondence, equation compiler and renderer, representative equation migrations, constrained LLM draft compilation, minimal DiagramScene and SVG adapter, focused tests, documentation, and Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: No second clock, broad CAS, arbitrary target-math generation, LLM-authored DOM or pixels or keyframes, live model provider, general diagram layout engine, unrelated dashboard export media work, or deferred family expansion.
